# Threads trending topics

Updated: Nov 13, 2026

The Threads Trending Topics API provides businesses with data on current trending topics being surfaced on the Threads app, and lets you retrieve the top and recent posts for each trend.

## Before you begin

- All API requests must include the app’s [Threads access token](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/get-started/app-access-tokens).

## Limitations

- The Threads Trending Topics API is only for retrieving public trends and their related Threads posts. You may not transfer or modify trending Threads data, and you must restrict your app users from transferring or modifying trending Threads data.
- Only trending topics being surfaced on the Threads app for the following jurisdictions are available through the API:
  - USA
  - Japan

The Threads Trending Topics API requires an appropriate access token and feature approval.

- **Threads Trending Topics** feature — Required for making `GET` calls to the `/trending_topics` and `/<trend_id>/posts` endpoints.

If your app has not been approved for the **Threads Trending Topics** feature, you can only call the `/trending_topics` endpoint with **basic** access. Calling `/<trend_id>/posts` endpoint to retrieve posts related to a trending topic requires **advanced** access for the **Threads Trending Topics** feature.

## Rate limiting

- Standard [Threads API rate limits](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/overview#rate-limiting) apply.
- Trending topics only change at most once every hour.

## Retrieve trending topics by country code

**Endpoint:** `GET graph.threads.com/trending_topics?country_code=...`

### Parameters

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `access_token` string | **Required.** Threads API [app access token](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/get-started/app-access-tokens). **Example:** `"TH\|<THREADS_APP_ID>\|<THREADS_APP_SECRET>"` |
| `country_code` string | **Required.** The country code of the country to fetch trending topics from. **Values:** `US`, `JP` |

### Returned fields

These are the **fields** for each object in the returned `trends` list.

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `title` string | The display name of the trend. |
| `description` string | A description of the trend. **Note:** This field is not available in the Japan jurisdiction. |
| `trend_id` numeric string | The identifier of the trend object. |

### Example request

```
curl -i -G \
  -d "country_code=US" \
  -d "access_token=<APP_ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
"https://graph.threads.com/v1.0/trending_topics"
```

### Example response

```
{
  "trends": [
    {
      "title": "Solar eclipse 2026",
      "description": "Total solar eclipse visible across parts of Europe and North Africa on August 12",
      "trend_id": "9876543210123456"
    },
    {
      "title": "World Cup draw",
      "description": "Groups revealed for the 2026 FIFA World Cup",
      "trend_id": "1234567890987654"
    },
    {
      "title": "Cherry blossom season",
      "description": "Peak cherry blossom season arrives early in several cities",
      "trend_id": "4567890123456789"
    },
    {
      "title": "New album Friday",
      "description": "Highly anticipated album releases dropping this Friday",
      "trend_id": "7890123456789012"
    },
    {
      "title": "Mars rover update",
      "description": "Mars rover captures high-resolution images of ancient river delta",
      "trend_id": "3210987654321098"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Retrieve trending posts by trend ID

**Endpoint:** `GET graph.threads.com/{trend-id}/posts?trending_post_type=...`

### Parameters

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `access_token` string | **Required.** Threads API [app access token](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/get-started/app-access-tokens). **Example:** `"TH\|<THREADS_APP_ID>\|<THREADS_APP_SECRET>"` |
| `trending_post_type` string | **Optional.** Whether to fetch recent or top posts associated with a trend. **Values:** `recent`, `top` |

### Returned fields

These are commonly requested fields for a post object. You can also request other fields from the [Media retrieval](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/reference/media-retrieval) reference section, except for the unsupported fields listed below.

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `username` string | Username of the Threads user who created the post. |
| `id` numeric string | Unique identifier of the Threads post. |
| `text` string | The text of the Threads post. Returned for text-only posts, but optional for image, video, and carousel posts. |
| `timestamp` string | The date and time when the post was published returned in ISO 8601 format. |
| `media_type` string | The media type for the Threads post. **Values:** `TEXT_POST`, `IMAGE`, `VIDEO`, `CAROUSEL_ALBUM`, `AUDIO`, `REPOST_FACADE` |
| `media_url` URL string | The post’s media URL (if any). This is only returned for posts with images, videos, or both. |
| `gif_url` URL string | The URL of a GIF attached to the post (if any). This is only returned for posts that have a GIF attachment. |
| `permalink` URL string | Permanent link to the Threads post. |

### Unsupported fields

The following fields are not supported on this endpoint:

- **Reply fields:**`conversation`, `has_replies`, `hide_status`, `is_reply`, `is_reply_owned_by_me`, `replied_to`, `replies`, `reply_approval_status`, `reply_approvals_enabled`, `reply_audience`, `root_post`
- **Owner and visibility fields:**`owner`, `allowlisted_country_codes`, `ghost_post_status`, `ghost_post_expiration_timestamp`
- **Content and attachment fields:**`children`, `poll_attachment`, `text_attachment`, `text_entities`
- **Other fields:**`deleted_at`, `insights`, `location_id`

### Example request

```
curl -i -G \
  -d "trending_post_type=top" \
  -d "fields=id,media_url,text,media_type" \
  -d "access_token=<APP_ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
"https://graph.threads.com/v1.0/<TREND_ID>/posts"
```

### Example response

```
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "18012345678901234",
      "media_url": "https://scontent.cdninstagram.com/...",
      "text": "Just witnessed the most incredible solar eclipse from my rooftop. The way the sky changed colors was unreal",
      "media_type": "IMAGE"
    },
    {
      "id": "18098765432109876",
      "text": "Fun fact: the next total solar eclipse visible from the same path won't happen for another 375 years!",
      "media_type": "TEXT_POST"
    },
    {
      "id": "18056789012345678",
      "media_url": "https://scontent.cdninstagram.com/...",
      "text": "Time-lapse of today's eclipse from start to finish. 4 hours compressed into 60 seconds",
      "media_type": "VIDEO"
    },
    {
      "id": "18034567890123456",
      "media_url": "https://scontent.cdninstagram.com/...",
      "text": "Our astronomy club set up 12 telescopes in the park for public viewing. Over 500 people showed up!",
      "media_type": "CAROUSEL_ALBUM"
    }
  ],
  "paging": {
    "cursors": {
      "after": "QVFIUnpKR0x2ZDZAMVXN0RjBnME1YekFEbW..."
    },
    "next": "https://graph.threads.com/v1.0/9876543210123456/posts?access_token=<ACCESS_TOKEN>&fields=id%2Cmedia_url%2Ctext%2Cmedia_type&pretty=0&trending_post_type=top&limit=25&after=QVFIUnpK..."
  }
}
```
